q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Li Na. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, a big city in the east of China. I live with my parents and my grandmother. I find English the easiest subject at school, because I read English stories at home and I love learning new words. I usually listen to pop music, and sometimes I listen to film music when I do my homework. I like cats best, because they’re quiet and soft. Yes, I like shopping, especially for clothes and books, but I don’t like it when the shops are crowded. I take photos almost every weekend, because I like taking pictures of flowers and my friends. I like funny films and cartoons, because they make me laugh. I usually meet my friends at the library or in the park near my home. I sometimes play games on my phone, but only at the weekend, because I’m busy with school during the week.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都用完整句子作答，并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…, especially…），能用一般现在时、频率副词和 like/enjoy doing 等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see an art class. There are some teenagers and a teacher in a big classroom with large windows. The students are wearing white school shirts and aprons, and they’re standing round a big wooden table. I think they’re making something with paper or cloth, maybe masks or puppets, because there are lots of colourful masks hanging from the ceiling. In the middle, there’s an orange bucket, maybe for water or glue. The teacher is standing behind the students. He’s wearing an orange apron and a tie, and he’s watching what they are doing. On the left, a girl with long hair is working hard. The students look happy and interested. I think they’re enjoying the lesson, and maybe they’ll show their work at a school art exhibition.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要说清人物在做什么、穿什么、在哪里，以及其他物品，用 in the middle / on the left / behind 等方位词组织，并用 I think / maybe 合理推测；不会的词（如 apron）可以换种说法，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. A cup is special, and the team can show it to everyone at the club. But only one person can take it home. I like the T-shirts too, because every player gets one and they can wear them for training. I agree with you about the money – it’s not very exciting, and they might argue about how to share it. Chocolates are nice, but they’ll eat them in one day, and I don’t think teenagers want flowers very much. The water bottles are really useful, because players need to drink a lot when they play volleyball. The toy monkey is funny, but I think it’s better for younger children. In my opinion, the T-shirts are the best, because everyone can have one and they’ll remember the competition. So shall we choose the T-shirts? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），比较不同奖品的优缺点，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的奖品。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I’ve played volleyball a few times in PE lessons. It’s fun, but I’m not very good at it because I’m quite short. I enjoy watching football on TV, because it’s exciting and my whole family watches it together. I’d like to try rock climbing, because it looks exciting and it’s good for your body. I think the best way to keep fit is to do some exercise every day, like running or cycling, and to eat healthy food. Yes, I think it’s important for students to do sport every day, because we sit in the classroom for a long time and sport helps us relax. But it doesn’t have to be a long time – thirty minutes is enough.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题表明观点并给出理由或具体例子，能用现在完成时（I’ve played…）和 would like to 谈经历和愿望，用 because / but / for example 展开，必要时回应 What do you think? 等追问。
